about_the_game:
Kashtah — a slang term meaning “trip to the desert” — invites you into a haunting journey through an abandoned Saudi Arabian village where silence hides unspeakable horrors.

Your car breaks down in the middle of nowhere. Seeking help, you stumble upon a deserted settlement surrounding a cursed castle. What begins as a desperate search for safety soon becomes a battle for survival.

Explore, investigate, and survive as you uncover the dark history buried beneath the sands. You will find clues, solve puzzles and escape from enemies until you find an escape path

🕹️ Gameplay Features :

  • Solo Survival Horror: Explore the desert town and castle corridors in first-person view.

  • Exploration & Puzzle Solving: Find keys, tools, and notes that reveal the castle’s secrets and open new paths.

  • Dynamic Environment: Switch between indoor and outdoor zones filled with chilling atmospheres, realistic lighting, and environmental storytelling.

  • Multiple Escape Routes: Every decision impacts your chances of survival—choose your path wisely.

  • Cultural Setting: Inspired by authentic Saudi architecture, myths, and desert landscapes.

  • Terror & Mystery: Face psychological horror, supernatural encounters, and heart-pounding chases.

Can you escape the curse of Kashtah, or will the desert claim another lost soul?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains suspenseful horror themes, jump scares, and intense moments of fear. Players may encounter disturbing imagery, blood, and violence involving supernatural entities.
There are no depictions of sexual content, drug use, or self-harm. The mature content is limited to psychological tension, dark story elements, and scary atmospheres that may not be suitable for all audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 (4 GB) or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12400
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible audio device
